name: noootwo-vibe
description: A Noootwo multi-skill workspace for controlled AI software development, user-centered product decisions, design, code review, and documentation.

interface.longDescription: Noootwo Vibe bundles focused skills for lightweight AI workflow control, user-centered product scope and flow decisions, research-backed design work, lens-based code-health review, and documentation hygiene.
defaultPrompt: Use Noootwo Workflow to plan this development task, run lifecycle guardrails, and route to the right specialist skill.
Use Noootwo Product when requirements, user flows, feature scope, states, or acceptance criteria need a real-user product checkpoint or product choice challenge.
Use Noootwo Design for UI, visual, artifact, or frontend design work after the product path is clear, without forcing the full .noootwo harness onto quick polish.
Use Noootwo Review to choose relevant review lenses and check architecture boundaries, test strategy, code quality, performance risk, lean-review bloat, and refactoring risk before release.
Use Noootwo Docs to update project documentation after stable workflow, product, design, review, release, or repository facts change.
